title: aphaeresis (fovariant-22)

freshResult.formula: Exists q0: cylinder. Exists q1: cube. Forall q2: cylinder. left(q1,q2)

referenceResult.formula: Exists q0: cube. Exists q1: cylinder. Forall q2: cylinder. left(q0,q2)

intendedConcept: There is a cube and there is a cylinder to the left of all cubes.
